chapters.title: Return to me
chapters.summary: Return to Me, and I will return to you. Zechariah's first night vision shows horsemen patrolling the earth, and God's promise to comfort Zion.

chapters.title: A wall of fire
chapters.summary: A man measures Jerusalem, but God says He will be a wall of fire around her and the glory within her. Many nations will join the Lord.

chapters.title: Clean garments
chapters.summary: The high priest Joshua stands in filthy clothes, accused by Satan. God rebukes the accuser, and Joshua is given clean garments. My servant the Branch is coming.

chapters.title: Not by might
chapters.summary: A golden lampstand fed by two olive trees: not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the Lord. Do not despise the day of small things.

chapters.title: The flying scroll
chapters.summary: A huge flying scroll brings a curse on thieves and liars, and a woman in a basket pictures wickedness being removed from the land.

chapters.title: The Branch will build
chapters.summary: Four chariots go out across the earth. Joshua is crowned as a sign of the Branch, who will build the temple and rule as priest and king.

chapters.title: Justice, not fasting
chapters.summary: Asked about fasting, God says what He wanted was true justice, mercy and compassion, and care for the widow, orphan, stranger and poor.

chapters.title: Jerusalem restored
chapters.summary: God will return to Zion. Old people will sit in the streets and children play. Many will say: let us go with you, for God is with you.

chapters.title: Your King comes
chapters.summary: Rejoice, daughter of Zion: your King comes, righteous and humble, riding on a donkey. He will speak peace to the nations.

chapters.title: The shepherd gathers
chapters.summary: Ask the Lord for rain. God cares for His flock and will strengthen Judah and gather His scattered people.

chapters.title: Thirty pieces of silver
chapters.summary: The prophet shepherds a flock doomed to slaughter and is paid thirty pieces of silver, which he throws to the potter in the temple.

chapters.title: Him whom they pierced
chapters.summary: God will defend Jerusalem and pour out a spirit of grace. They will look on Me whom they have pierced and mourn as for an only son.

chapters.title: A fountain for cleansing
chapters.summary: A fountain will be opened to cleanse sin and impurity. Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, but a refined remnant will call on God.

chapters.title: The Lord will be king
chapters.summary: On the day of the Lord, living waters will flow from Jerusalem and the Lord will be king over all the earth. Holiness to the Lord will be on everything.
